images.caption: Front and eastern side of the House on Huron Avenue, located at 5721 Huron Street in Vermilion, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1820, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: An island-town cottage lot: House on Huron Avenue, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a house on Huron Avenue (Vermilion, 1880s): a white two-storey gable-front Greek Revival house with green shutters and window boxes, a lattice-skirted porch, mostly hidden behind an enormous weeping willow
